name: Coral Newsprints Ltd
summary: Coral Newsprints Ltd. is primarily involved in the production of newsprint and absorbent kraft paper, which are available in a range of different weights. The company's business activities are divided into four main operational areas: Writing and Printing Paper, Industrial Packaging Paper, Specialty Paper, and Newsprint. Established on April 21, 1992, its corporate headquarters are located in New Delhi, India.
